title: Post hoc analysis of the SIRFLOX study: radiomics analysis of baseline CT images with the intention to identify predictors of superior response and overall survival to a combined treatment approach (SIRT plus chemotherapy) as compared to chemotherapy alone
summary: This study is investigating whether certain features on CT images of the liver and other areas of the body taken before treatment can predict the course of the disease and the survival of patients. The aim is to find factors that are associated with the treatment outcome and can support the decision for the best therapy. This should enable better prognoses to be made and treatment to be customized.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile duct

interventions.name:
Feature extraction will be performed from all baseline CT scans of the SIRFLOX study (both treatment arms), focusing primarily on liver 
metastases. Feature extraction includes optimization of hyperparameters, such as the width of smoothing kernels, discretization levels and other parameters. After

Exclusion criteria:
